thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — we need to prioritize a compact subset of the corpus for the q8b-int4 bringup. Labeling capacity is tight and the corpus has a lot of near-duplicates. Need: prioritized sample set, de-dupe plan, golden refresh. Who can own short plan?
kevin: How many samples are we aiming for and which slices?
maria: Target ~1.5k candidates, hand off 400 for labels, 50 for golden re-eval. Main slices: long prompts (>512), code examples, RAG context length >2000, and non-english fallback. Sample query (rough):
```sql
SELECT id, prompt, source, token_len FROM corpus
WHERE token_len > 512 OR source IN ('code','rag')
ORDER BY rand()
LIMIT 1500;
```
ashley: Capacity wise we can only onboard ~250 labels this sprint unless we throttle other campaigns. Can reserve 200 for q8b if we pause one low-priority queue.
label-bot: Automation: reserved 200 labels from pool `q8b_onboard_pool` — scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
tom: I'll run fuzzyhash de-dupe but watch out — tokenizer changes (v2) shift fingerprints. Plan: fuzzy threshold 0.85, run with `--tokenizer v1,v2` to compare collisions.
jun: We should refresh golden set with 50 new seeds post-de-dupe and run a smoke eval against current q8b-int4 baseline. I can run smoke eval if someone seeds the golden set. Timeline?
maria: Proposed timeline: collect candidates by +24h (1765518622), de-dupe run +30h, produce final 600 candidates +36h, labelers start +48h, golden relabel +72h, smoke eval +78h. :rocket:
ashley: I'll message labelers about FIFO throttle and mark the campaign `q8b_onboard` with high priority. Please add expected avg time per label (I estimate 90s).
kevin: Add monitoring tag `q8b_onboard/curation` in console dashboards and drop a summary in #eng-ml when de-dupe + first label batch complete. Also include sample attr breakdown (slice counts).
maria: Ack — I'll post updates and attach sampling SQL + dedupe logs. Thanks all :heart:
